انتزعوا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَزَعُوا (intazaʕū) /in.ta.za.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# اُنْتُزِعُوا (untuziʕū) /un.tu.zi.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# اِنْتَزِعُوا (intaziʕū) /in.ta.zi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
